title: About Isolation Banner Notifications for Internet & SaaS

blocks.text: When a user in your organization enters an isolated session, a notification appears to them in the web browser. This end-user notification can be customized to align with an organization's look and feel.
The notification banners are assigned per isolation profile. To learn more, see About Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS and Creating Isolation Profiles for Internet & SaaS.

Admins can manage custom banner themes for the end-user notification that appears when a user in their organization enters isolation. They can create and edit as many custom themes as they want, and delete any that are not the default theme.
On the Isolation Banners page (Zero Trust Browser > Browser Isolation Internet Access > Isolation Profile & Banner > Isolation Banner), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Show or hide available columns in the table.
Go to the Isolation Profiles page.
